programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u076/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols]
    sep_color = Counter(sep_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_ranges = [(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1) if row_bounds[i+1] > row_bounds[i]+1]
    col_ranges = [(col_bounds[i]+1, col_bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1) if col_bounds[i+1] > col_bounds[i]+1]
    tile_colors = [grid[r][c] for ra, rb in row_ranges for ca, cb in col_ranges for r in range(ra,rb) for c in range(ca,cb) if grid[r][c] != sep_color]
    background = Counter(tile_colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in row_ranges:
        row = []
        for ca, cb in col_ranges:
            marks = sum(grid[r][c] not in (sep_color, background) for r in range(ra,rb) for c in range(ca,cb))
            row.append(1 if marks > 1 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
